recent_donors.name: Michelle Andrews
recent_donors.message: To dear Ethan, Austin, Issac and Lachlan, I came to know about you through reading an article in the Newcastle Herald. Each of you are making a difference- indeed just being prepared to stand up and put a spotlight on the devastating impact that mental illness can have is an achievement. You've gone that extra mile (and then some!!); you've raised some much-needed funds, and you have honoured the memory of your friend. With young men like yourselves setting such a positive example, I feel hopeful for a brighter tomorrow. Best wishes.
